title: 阿甘正傳
description: 經典勵志電影，阿甘的奇妙人生

sentences.en: Life is like a box of chocolates.
My mama always said life was like a box of chocolates.
sentences.zh: 我媽媽總說人生就像一盒巧克力。

sentences.en: You never know what you're gonna get.
sentences.zh: 你永遠不知道你會得到什麼。

sentences.en: I'm not a smart man, but I know what love is.
sentences.zh: 我不聰明，但我知道什麼是愛。

sentences.en: There's only so much of a person you can love before you can't anymore.
sentences.zh: 一個人能愛的有限，愛過之後就不能再愛了。

sentences.en: I don't know if we each have a destiny.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我們每個人是否有命運。

sentences.en: It was the best thing that ever happened to me.
sentences.zh: 那是我身上發生的最好的事。

sentences.en: We have to see the good in each other.
sentences.zh: 我們必須看到彼此的好。
